title: Homepage navigation reaches contact
description: A visitor can use the global navigation from the homepage to open the contact page and start an inquiry.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to view the contact page
Verify the contact page form is displayed

title: Submit a complete contact inquiry
description: A visitor can fill out the contact form with valid details and receive confirmation that the inquiry was sent.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Fill in the name field with Alex Johnson
Fill in the email field with alex.johnson@example.com
Fill in the message field with I would like to learn more about your career services.
Submit the contact form
Verify a success confirmation is visible
